dslRule:
<!id: swt.shell.isDisposed.check>
<!description: Add isDisposed() check before accessing SWT Shell attributes to prevent Widget disposed exception.>
<!severity: WARNING>

$shell.getDisplay().getActiveShell() == $shell
=>
!$shell.isDisposed() && $shell.getDisplay().getActiveShell() == $shell
;;
summary: Add `!isDisposed()` check before accessing SWT Shell.
